mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET isRead = TRUE WHERE memberId = #{memberId} AND isRead = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE memberId = #{memberId} AND isRead = FALSE

SELECT n.id, n.memberId, n.type, n.message, n.isRead, n.regDate, n.relId, CASE WHEN n.type = 'FOLLOW' THEN m.nickName END AS extra__nickName FROM notification n LEFT JOIN member m ON n.type = 'FOLLOW' AND n.relId = m.id WHERE n.memberId = #{memberId} ORDER BY n.regDate DESC LIMIT 30
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (memberId, type, message, isRead, regDate, relId) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{type}, #{message}, #{isRead}, NOW(), #{relId})
